meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的各个 git worktree、分支或 PR 拉进同一个共享聊天文件，每个各占一方分轮发言，最后产出一份整合计划：目标 worktree、合并顺序、冲突如何处理。全程只读，不提交不合并，结果用大白话讲给你。
howto.when: 当你在多个 git worktree、分支或 PR 上有并行改动，想理清如何合并时触发。候选少于两个时它会直接说明并停下，不开站会。

say.text: 帮我开个站会，把最近 4 小时活跃的 worktree 都叫上
say.note: 先列出候选名单让你确认，再开始

say.text: 把分支 feature-x 和 PR 42 拉进这次站会
say.note: 展示编号列表，你回复勾选

say.text: 用大白话说说这次站会的结论
say.note: 给出目标 worktree、合并顺序和要你拍板的事

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a read-only standup across your git worktrees, branches, or PRs: each joins one shared chat, reconciles in rounds, then produces one consolidation plan in plain language. It never commits or merges.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have parallel work across several git worktrees, branches, or PRs and want to sort out how to merge them. With fewer than two candidates it says so, offers to widen, and stops.

say_en.text: Hold a standup for worktrees active in the last 4 hours
say_en.note: It lists the active worktrees for you to confirm

say_en.text: Add branch feature-x and PR 42 to this standup
say_en.note: Shows one numbered list of branches and PRs

say_en.text: Explain the standup outcome in plain language
say_en.note: Target worktree, merge order, and what needs your call
